panel.title: Autosave
toggle.label: Autosave draft
status.off: Autosave is off. Use Save to store changes.
status.unsaved-entry: Autosave starts after the first save.
status.invalid: Not saved: fix the errors in the form.
status.error: Save failed. It is tried again on the next change.
revert.title: Revert the draft?
revert.body: The draft goes back to how it was at {time}, before autosave changed it. Relation and media fields are not reverted.
